scene_analysis.scene_overview: A wide city street lined with tall buildings and trees, featuring a mix of commercial and residential properties along its length. The street is relatively empty, with only a few pedestrians and vehicles present. A bus is parked near the left side of the street, while several motorcycles are parked along the sidewalk. The street is paved with asphalt and has a central median with trees planted in large pots. The buildings on either side of the street have a mix of modern and traditional facades, with some featuring ornate details such as balconies and decorative trim. The street is well-lit, with streetlights spaced at regular intervals. The sky above is overcast, casting dappled shadows across the street. The overall atmosphere is quiet and peaceful, with a sense of urban tranquility.
